code: init_status = FLAC__stream_decoder_init_file(decoder_session->decoder, strcmp(infilename, "-")? infilename : 0, write_callback, metadata_callback, error_callback, /*client_data=*/decoder_session);
note: The attacker-supplied FLAC stream is decoded from stdin (infilename "-" passes NULL, so init_file_internal_ binds stdin); a stdin-backed decoder gets no tell callback, so every later FLAC__stream_decoder_get_decode_position() call will fail without writing its output variable.
For the stdin-backed decoder tell_callback is NULL, so get_decode_position returns false without initializing *position (dpos).

In analysis mode the return value of get_decode_position is ignored; the call fails (no tell callback for stdin / Ogg decoders) and leaves the local dpos uninitialized, violating the obligation that the output variable be initialized before use.
Uninitialized read: dpos was never written because get_decode_position failed, so frame_bytes is computed from an uninitialized value (use-of-uninitialized-value).
The poisoned frame_bytes (and decode_position) are passed into the per-frame analysis output, where the uninitialized value is consumed and reported by MemorySanitizer.
